_comment: Which lessons belong to which Stoffverteilungsplan. A lesson matches when BOTH the subject and one of its classes match - Doc teaches e.g. Lit and Inf in the same class, so the class alone is not enough. The number in a class name is the year the cohort entered (9a = OS22a, 5a = OS26a), so in SJ 2026/27 FO*26-* is Klasse 11 and FO*25-* is Klasse 12.
